_doc: satk.style golden numbers on the vanilla game (gta-sa-clean, SA 1.0 US), numbers only, no assets. mesh_metrics: satk.style.dffmesh.dff_metrics(<model>.dff from models/gta3.img, select='hd') = every atomic except *_dam and *_vlo, the wheel once, merged in model space. profiles: [p10, p50, p90] of the style cache peer set with a relative tolerance. Limits: build seconds (cold, with the process pool; the plan target is 30 s, the test allows headroom for a loaded machine), warm profile seconds and answer bytes, leave-one-out pass shares. Values with a tolerance are [value, tolerance]. Checked by tests/style/test_game.py.
